    // True when the horizontal ray from `point` towards +X crosses the edge
    // (a, b). The half-open rule on the y comparison (`a.Y > point.Y` exclusive-or
    // `b.Y > point.Y`) counts each vertex exactly once, so a ray through a vertex
    // does not double count.
    EdgeCrossesRay(a: Point2D, b: Point2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => (a.Y > point.Y).ExclusiveOr(b.Y > point.Y)
        && point.X < (b.X - a.X) * (point.Y - a.Y) / (b.Y - a.Y) + a.X;

    // True when `point` lies inside the closed ring, by the even-odd (crossing
    // number) rule: inside when the ray towards +X crosses an odd number of edges.
    // Exact for a simple (non-self-intersecting) ring; for a self-intersecting one
    // it reports the even-odd region rather than the non-zero-winding region.
    // Points exactly ON the boundary are not classified reliably — the strict `<`
    // in EdgeCrossesRay makes the answer depend on floating point, so callers that
    // need a boundary guarantee must test the boundary separately.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon
    PolygonContainsPoint(points: Array<Point2D>, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => points.Count
            .MapRange(i => EdgeCrossesRay(points[i], points.AtModulo(i + 1), point) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, c) => acc + c)
            .IsOdd;

    // The point of the segment [a, b] nearest to `point`: the projection parameter
    // clamped to [0, 1]. A degenerate segment (a equals b) returns a.
    ClosestPointOnSegment(a: Point2D, b: Point2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var ab = a.Between(b);
        var lengthSquared = ab.MagnitudeSquared;
        var t = lengthSquared <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : a.Between(point).Dot(ab) / lengthSquared;
        return a + ab * t.Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }

    // The point of the segment [a, b] in space nearest to `point`.
    ClosestPointOnSegment(a: Point3D, b: Point3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var ab = a.Between(b);
        var lengthSquared = ab.MagnitudeSquared;
        var t = lengthSquared <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : a.Between(point).Dot(ab) / lengthSquared;
        return a + ab * t.Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }

    // The distance from `point` to the segment [a, b].
    DistanceToSegment(a: Point2D, b: Point2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => ClosestPointOnSegment(a, b, point).Between(point).Magnitude;

    // The distance from `point` to the segment [a, b] in space.
    DistanceToSegment(a: Point3D, b: Point3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => ClosestPointOnSegment(a, b, point).Between(point).Magnitude;

    // The point of the polyline (or closed ring, when `closed`) nearest to `point`:
    // the nearest of the per-edge nearest points.
    ClosestPointOnChain(points: Array<Point2D>, closed: Boolean, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var candidates = (closed ? points.Count : points.Count - 1)
            .MapRange(i => ClosestPointOnSegment(points[i], points.AtModulo(i + 1), point));
        return candidates.Reduce(candidates.First, (best, c) =>
            c.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared < best.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared ? c : best);
    }

    // The point of the space polyline (or closed ring) nearest to `point`.
    ClosestPointOnChain(points: Array<Point3D>, closed: Boolean, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var candidates = (closed ? points.Count : points.Count - 1)
            .MapRange(i => ClosestPointOnSegment(points[i], points.AtModulo(i + 1), point));
        return candidates.Reduce(candidates.First, (best, c) =>
            c.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared < best.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared ? c : best);
    }

    //==
    // # Bounds, measures, and centroids
    //
    // Bodies for the IBounded2D / IBounded3D, ILength / IArea /
    // IVolume and ICentroid2D / ICentroid3D interfaces declared in
    // `geometry.concepts.plato`.
    //
    // Conventions used throughout:
    //   * Points are positions (`points.types.plato`); subtracting two points gives a vector
    //     via IDifference.Between(a, b), which yields (b - a). Vectors carry Magnitude /
    //     MagnitudeSquared (INormed) and Dot (IVector).
    //   * Distances are computed as the magnitude of a Between delta, so the argument
    //     order of Between never affects a distance result.
    //   * Measures are unit-agnostic Numbers in coordinate units (see README.md).
    //
    // Cross-package reuse (this library deliberately does NOT re-spell generics that lower
    // packages already ship):
    //   * P1: Half(IScalable), AlmostZero(IReal, tolerance).
    //   * P4: Center(IBounds<$TPoint>).

    //==
    // # ICentered2D / ICentered3D
    //
    // A shape stored about a centre it is symmetric in has that centre for its
    // centroid, which discharges ICentroid2D / ICentroid3D for every one of them.

    // The centroid of a centre-symmetric planar shape: its stored centre.
    Centroid(self: ICentered2D): Point2D
        => self.Center;

    // The centroid of a centre-symmetric solid or surface: its stored centre.
    Centroid(self: ICentered3D): Point3D
        => self.Center;

    //==
    // # IBounded2D
    //
    // Everything derived from the axis-aligned Bounds2D (Min / Max corners, each a
    // Point2D) — an AABB (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis-aligned_bounding_box;
    // see also https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bounding_volume). Named with a
    // `Bounds` prefix so nothing collides with the members IBounds itself
    // carries, and so BoundsCenter reads distinctly from a shape centroid.

    // The center of the bounding rectangle. Delegates to P4's Center(IBounds).
    BoundsCenter(self: IBounded2D): Point2D
        => self.Bounds.Center;

    // The extent of the bounding rectangle as a vector (Max - Min); components are
    // non-negative for a well-formed box.
    BoundsSize(self: IBounded2D): Vector2D
        => self.Bounds.Min.Between(self.Bounds.Max);

    // The horizontal extent of the bounding rectangle.
    BoundsWidth(self: IBounded2D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.X;

    // The vertical extent of the bounding rectangle.
    BoundsHeight(self: IBounded2D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.Y;

    // The area of the bounding rectangle (width times height).
    BoundsArea(self: IBounded2D): Number
        => self.BoundsWidth * self.BoundsHeight;

    // The length of the bounding rectangle's diagonal.
    BoundsDiagonalLength(self: IBounded2D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.Magnitude;

    // True when the point lies within the bounding rectangle (inclusive).
    BoundsContainsPoint(self: IBounded2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => point.X >= self.Bounds.Min.X && point.X <= self.Bounds.Max.X
        && point.Y >= self.Bounds.Min.Y && point.Y <= self.Bounds.Max.Y;

    // True when this shape's bounds lie entirely within `outer`'s bounds (inclusive).
    FitsInside(self: IBounded2D, outer: IBounded2D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Min.X >= outer.Bounds.Min.X && self.Bounds.Min.Y >= outer.Bounds.Min.Y
        && self.Bounds.Max.X <= outer.Bounds.Max.X && self.Bounds.Max.Y <= outer.Bounds.Max.Y;

    // True when the two shapes' bounding rectangles overlap (touching counts).
    BoundsOverlaps(self: IBounded2D, other: IBounded2D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Min.X <= other.Bounds.Max.X && self.Bounds.Max.X >= other.Bounds.Min.X
        && self.Bounds.Min.Y <= other.Bounds.Max.Y && self.Bounds.Max.Y >= other.Bounds.Min.Y;

    //==
    // # IBounded3D
    //
    // The 3D analogues over Bounds3D (Min / Max are Point3D).

    // The center of the bounding box. Delegates to P4's Center(IBounds).
    BoundsCenter(self: IBounded3D): Point3D
        => self.Bounds.Center;
